text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... Kris S-chan, Tap-chan, and 
Digital-chan, huh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: My stomach... Oww, my stomach...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enduring the daily pressure leading up to 
the Takarazuka Kinen, Hishi Miracle was 
just barely holding on, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that big TV over there... Is 
that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the news broadcast on the street 
TV, Hishi Miracle froze entirely in place.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! An unexpected challenger flies 
in from the Classic tier to enter the 
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe, the cosmic Umamusume who 
conquered both the Satsuki Sho and the 
Japanese Derby, has declared her entry!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe will 'sweep' the Takarazuka 
Kinen. In other words..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It might be "ABST." If you don't want to 
"communicate"—run.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, a-aaah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The invasion of a Double Crown Umamusume. 
A Classic-class powerhouse entering the 
Takarazuka Kinen is an exceptional rarity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A second helping of pressure. Finally, 
Hishi Miracle broke down mentally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The exam results showed no abnormalities 
anywhere in her body, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Training... I can do it. I should be able 
to. It's not an injury, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But still... why is that? *Brrrr*, 
shiver-shiver-shiver...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unceasing chills. Mind and body cannot be 
separated. I am in no state to focus on 
training at all...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, I really should do at least a 
little...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Your expectations, Trainer... *urgh*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her desire to meet expectations seems to 
have become a heavy burden as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Forced into a decision. Should I have her 
train just a little, or give her full 
rest?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The risk of resting at this timing is 
certainly high, but..."
choice_data_list: Let's take a break for a while.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, but if I don't make it in time~...
choice_data_list:
If that's how it is, so be it. Let's take 
the gamble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is a "gamble." Ever since we teamed 
up, we've kept on betting and kept on 
winning, and that's why we are where we 
are today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how badly things might turn out 
after letting her rest... I fully intended 
to take responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, I want to run... I wanna run so 
bad~. Even lying down in the infirmary, I 
just can't settle down...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Looking at it like this, the shadows on 
the ceiling...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(She looks just like Kris S-chan~... Eek, 
she looks super strong~)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I know there's nothing I can do right 
now. But...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Isn't Trainer... scared? What if resting 
makes me run out of time...?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I can't do it. Neither deciding to rest, 
nor deciding not to rest. Why is 
Trainer...?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Wait... What's this...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be... what Top Road-chan was 
talking about...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No... preparation whatsoever?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-chan, I don't think that's true at 
all. Definitely not.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A spurt like that can only be pulled off 
by someone who challenged themselves by 
their own will and pushed past their 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(It's a matter of resolve... isn't it? I 
really don't have enough resolve...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I've never been able to make decisions on 
my own. I thought Trainer's support was 
making up for that...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: But... that's not it, probably.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's right. The one who was making up 
for it was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, an exclusive contract... with you?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
D-Didn't this conversation just get blown 
way out of proportion?! Even if you drop 
that on me all of a sudden, it just 
doesn't feel real to me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Back when I showed zero promise, you 
still offered to be my exclusive 
trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The registration sheet for the Kikuka 
Sho...? And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, submitted...? Wait, doesn't that 
mean you've already decided~ !?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Pushing my indecisive self to take the 
plunge on a major showdown.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You meanie, demon, English teacher, 
Trainer! That's so cruel~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? I might end up hating you, 
Trainer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(She only set up that grueling schedule 
for my sake. And yet she even took on the 
role of the villain for me...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right, the one who was making up for it 
was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer's... "resolve."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Everything... even the parts I can't 
decide on my own...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Carrying all the hardships and fears on 
your own, you placed your bet on me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you lose, you're the villain. Even so, 
because you kept winning, we made it this 
far...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So... that was it...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That Trainer decided to "let them rest for 
now"...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I made them decide again. But they 
decided for me. And yet......"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Can't I even get some rest?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Can't you even manage doing nothing? 
That's just...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright—I'm resting. I'm not gonna think 
about a thing and just rest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The current me is still no good. I still 
haven't found my positive mindset.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, she's already up at the 
ceiling—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan isn't here! I have to 
take—this gamble!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm fine now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes. My heart is completely set.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Once I stayed still in bed, I got used to 
it. Completely."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was strange... Hishi Miracle somehow 
looked strikingly dignified...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did the rest do that much good? At the 
very least, one thing became clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Giving her rest." That gamble had without 
a doubt paid off.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I don't have... as much courage 
as you do. But—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I want to become someone who can give back 
the absolute most to everyone who took a 
chance on me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So, that's why—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Off to training I go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was the slight flush on her face because 
she had just recovered from an illness, or 
was it from the heat?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Hishi Miracle sprinted, her back 
emanated an unmistakable surge of fighting 
spirit like never before.
